connector.name: Jamp
connector.registryDescription: Agent-run site monitoring: install JAMP, read errors, uptime, vitals and traffic, resolve fixes.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.jamp.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package jamp-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jdwilliums account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: JAMP_API_TOKEN
env.description: JAMP API token from Settings > API & MCP access (tick write access for the setup tools)
